review_scope: Every unit-wordlist headword and unit grouping visually checked against rendered source pages. Repetitions and proper names retained. Alphabetical/name/irregular-verb supplements retained separately and not double-counted. IPA, Chinese gloss, POS, variants and individual typography remain untranscribed null.

source_legend.boldface: 重点词汇用黑体标出: bold marks key vocabulary, not the national level-2 or recognition-only star category. Individual bold flags are not transcribed.
source_legend.pronunciation_order: Where British/American pronunciations differ, British first and American second, except grade6-upper whose reviewed legend only states boldface.
source_legend.p_numbers: Literal source printed body-page references; retained when native association is unambiguous. Source reference mistakes are not silently corrected.
source_legend.alphabetical_scope: Alphabetical index is separate evidence; its entries/page references can differ from unit lists. This audit does not assert exact equivalence or exhaustive reconciliation.
